skills.name: Write a test
skills.teaches: Write the pytest case first and watch it fail for the right reason. A test that has never failed proves nothing.

skills.name: Debug a failing test
skills.teaches: Read the traceback from the bottom up before you change anything, and find the smallest change that makes it pass. Keep the test.

skills.name: Add a route
skills.teaches: Add the route to the FastAPI or Flask app and keep the handler thin. The handler reads the request and calls a function that does the work.

skills.name: Add an endpoint with validation
skills.teaches: Declare the request body as a pydantic model so a bad request is rejected before any work starts. Everything below the model can trust what it got.

skills.name: Write a migration
skills.teaches: Change the schema in an alembic revision that runs once and replays on an empty database. Write the downgrade, and never edit a revision that has shipped.

skills.name: Verify a webhook signature
skills.teaches: Reject any request whose signature does not match, using the raw body and hmac.compare_digest.

skills.name: Honor an idempotency key
skills.teaches: Take a key from the caller, store the result under it, and return that same result when the key comes back. A retry must not charge twice.

skills.name: Guard a race
skills.teaches: When two requests can change the same record, make the change one atomic step: a conditional update, a transaction, or a unique constraint. Reading and then writing leaves a gap another request can land in, whether across one await or across two workers.

skills.name: Set a deadline
skills.teaches: Give every call that leaves the process a timeout, with asyncio.timeout or the client's own, and let the cancellation reach the work under it. A call with no deadline can hold a request open forever.

skills.name: Retry with backoff
skills.teaches: Retry only the calls that are safe to repeat, sleep longer after each attempt, and add jitter so every client does not come back at once. Stop at a bound and raise.

skills.name: Limit concurrency
skills.teaches: Run independent calls together under an asyncio.Semaphore, never more than a set number at once. Decide up front whether one failure cancels the rest, as a TaskGroup does, or everything finishes and reports.

skills.name: Handle an error boundary
skills.teaches: Decide at the boundary which exceptions the caller sees and which only reach the log. Map each one to a status and a message that gives nothing away.

skills.name: Add a background job
skills.teaches: Move slow work off the request into a queue worker or a scheduled job, and make the job safe to run twice. The request records the work, the worker does it.
